name: BSP_SubmarineClass_ReadLuaFields
evidence: Hypothesis for the ReadLuaFields part, not a recovered symbol; the class name is recovered data, the literal at 00D1AE68 that follows the leaf vtable 00D1AE38. Slot +8h override of the vehicle class descriptor vtable, __thiscall(descriptor, LuaObject* row) with RET 4, chaining to 00831840 BSP_ShipClass_ReadLuaFields before its own first key. MSubmarine. Thirteen keys into +80Ch..+83Ch, all floats through 00B66330 except PeriscopeWave, which is guarded by 00B66A60 IsInteger and wrapped by 00870CD0 into +80Ch. SwimDepth1 writes the same slot +810h as PeriscopeDepth and is only read when that left it negative (COMISS then JBE at 00854332), so it is the legacy alias, not a second field. The only leaf whose four tuning slots differ: +60h, +64h, +68h, +6Ch into +560h..+56Ch and +5Ch into +570h. docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_LUA_LOAD.md.

name: BSP_TurningGun_ApplyAnglesToNodes
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(gun). Builds a Y rotation by -horzAngle for the node at gun+3BCh and an X rotation by -vertAngle for the node at gun+3C8h, each keeping the node translation, and installs them through node vtable[38h]. With no elevation node it multiplies two rotations and sets one node. docs/GUN_AIMING.md.

name: BSP_TurningGun_Update

name: BSP_TurningGun_SetTargetAngles
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(gun)(float horz, float vert) -> bool, RET 8. Writes -1.0f to gun+4A0h first, wraps both angles into (-pi, pi] with fmod, refuses a pair no traverse window of the platform contains (007F5FC0 at 0085AC94) and refuses either axis whose descriptor rotation speed is zero (0085ACA5, 0085ACB9), then writes tHorzAngle at gun+494h and tVertAngle at gun+498h. docs/GUN_AIMING.md.

name: BSP_TurningGun_StepAim
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(gun+310h)(float dt), RET 4 at 0085B0E0. Slot +4h of the tick-element vtable block at 00CFE504; the body reaches the gun with a -310h bias. Gates on unit+5Dh and gun+3B8h, snaps an axis whose descriptor rate (+88h HorzRotSpeed, +8Ch VertRotSpeed) is at or below zero, ends on a 0.000174533 rad dead band (00CFAA48), takes signed deltas from 007F6530, clamps each to rate*dt, and scales by 00419010(0, 0.5, 10deg, 1.0, remaining) for every class except 23h MRFSGun (the vtable[5Ch] test at 0085AF76 and 0085B064). docs/GUN_AIMING.md.

name: BSP_TurningGun_SetAnglesImmediate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(gun)(float tHorz, float tVert, float horz, float vert), RET 10h. The replication snap: writes the current pair only when the wrapped difference exceeds 0.8 rad (00CE3D40) and an arc search accepts the candidate, always writes the target pair, ends with 00859550. Partial: 0085B108-0085B720 unread. docs/GUN_AIMING.md.

name: BSP_TurningGun_AimAtWorldDirection
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(gun)(vector). Transforms a world direction into the gun frame, normalises, clamps the y component to minus one through one, and calls 0085ABA0 with the negated atan2 of x and z as the horizontal angle and the asin of y as the vertical angle. docs/GUN_AIMING.md.
